# Audit Trail

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table workspace tab.

The first folder level is a **sidebar menu item**; the files inside it are that menu item's **workspace tabs**. The menu never nests deeper, and the tabs never gain a category row above them.

## Leaf menu items

| Menu item | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Approval History](approval-history.md) | `approval-history` | Provides an immutable, read-only table for reviewing approval history and tracing each event to its source record, actor, permission, and correlation identifier. |
| [Data Exports](data-exports.md) | `data-exports` | Provides an immutable, read-only table for reviewing data exports and tracing each event to its source record, actor, permission, and correlation identifier. |
| [Posting History](posting-history.md) | `posting-history` | Provides an immutable, read-only table for reviewing posting history and tracing each event to its source record, actor, permission, and correlation identifier. |
| [Reversals & Voids](reversals-and-voids.md) | `reversals-and-voids` | Provides an immutable, read-only table for reviewing reversals & voids and tracing each event to its source record, actor, permission, and correlation identifier. |
| [Transaction History](transaction-history.md) | `transaction-history` | Provides an immutable, read-only table for reviewing transaction history and tracing each event to its source record, actor, permission, and correlation identifier. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed workspace tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
